title: Tagged configuration
statement: Let $d$ be a natural number, let $S_j$ be a state set for each $j<d$, and fix an input string. Given an index $j<d$ and a configuration on $K$ Boolean work tapes with state set $S_j$, define a configuration with tagged states: each present state $q$ becomes the pair $(j,q)$, while a missing state remains missing. The input head position, work tapes, work head positions, and output are unchanged.
